label: INFERENCE
extraction: OpenAI Agents SDK: official framework for building agents using function-calling and agent handoffs. Emphasizes lightweight runtime and guardrails for safety. Key pattern: agent handoffs where one agent 'hands off' conversation to another via Handoff(TargetAgent). Benefit: no central manager bottleneck, conversation flows naturally between specialized entities. Swarms pattern popularized late 2024 focuses on handoffs. Cross-vendor orchestration via A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol enables multi-agent pattern where agents from different frameworks/runtimes can interoperate. Before A2A, multi-agent systems required shared framework and runtime.
